title: Understanding the parameters in the app
breadcrumb: Understanding the parameters in the app
label: LAZADA · DEVELOPER GUIDE
subtitle: Last modified 2026-06-23 10:27:33
html:
After creating an app, you’ll see this information on the app details page. I’ll list and explain the most important parameters.

App Key

The App Key is the unique identifier for the Lazada Open Platform app and is one of the required parameters when calling the Lazada Open API.

App Secret

The App Secret is a secret key assigned to the app by the Lazada Open Platform to ensure the security and reliability of requests initiated by the app. Please ensure that you keep the App Secret secure and do not disclose it or share it with any third party.

Sensitive Data Privliege

The “Sensitive Data Privilege” is used to indicate whether your app has passed a security audit; only apps that have passed the security audit can access buyers' personal information.

App Status

App Status is used to indicate the current status of your service.

The “Testing” status is for testing purposes only; it is limited to 10,000 API calls per day and has a shorter access token validity period.

You can apply for the “Online” status by clicking “Apply Online” in the upper-right corner after testing is complete. Please do not apply for this status before development is finished, as this action is irreversible. If your app category falls under the “Enterprises Commercial” partner type, this will result in the authorization policy changing to “Allow subscribers to authorize” and require you to publicly release your service on the service marketplace.

The “Offline” status can be used after the app has entered the “Online” status. In this status, all requests initiated using this App Key are blocked.

API Call Limit

The API Call Limit is the number of API calls your App Key can make every 24 hours. Typically, the limit is 10,000 per day for the “Testing” status and 10,000,000 per day for the “Online” status.

Authorization Information & Authorized Seller Whitelist

Please refer to the “Seller Authorization Introduction” document.

API Permission Group

The “API Permission Group” lists the APIs that your App Key is currently authorized to call. Permissions typically vary depending on your app's category. If your App Key does not include the API permissions you need, you can submit a support ticket via the control bar to inquire whether the relevant API permissions can be added for you.

IP Whitelist

The IP Whitelist is used to restrict request IPs; only IPs on the whitelist can use your App Key to initiate requests. If left blank, there are no restrictions.

IPv6 is not supported;

If there are multiple IPs, please separate them with a “;”.

Push Mechanism

Proactive callbacks initiated by the open platform are triggered only while the access token is valid.
